consequence.statement: CI infrastructure improvement with no impact on Argo CD deployments or operator environments.

original.statement: A CI workflow bugfix corrects previous version detection and workflow failure conditions; this is a development process change with no documented operational consequence.

decision.reason: [ev-9c156d0eceea] lists this commit as "fix(ci): get correct previous version, fail workflow if not". The "ci" scope means it changes the project's own release/CI workflow, not anything an Argo CD installation runs or is configured with. Nothing in the excerpt says anything fails, is rejected or works differently for an operator, so "none" (informational) fits and claims no mandatory work.
